summary_markdown:
A data issue was identified where a staging area (STAGE) had been partially cleared, leaving only AFA records. The discussion focused on restoring the lost data and recalculating the aggregates.

*   The initial query provided showed the structure of the affected data set.
*   It was determined that the best course of action was to restore the stage rather than attempting a direct recovery from production.
*   A new field was added to the aggregates, which helped in the process.
*   The final step involved restoring the aggregate stage using predictive staging data.
decisions: The affected staging area (STAGE) will be restored and recalculated.
